**STEP 2 - Ruler:** The white square plate is about 26 cm across, so I treat it as a 26 cm plate. Area ≈ 3.14 × 13² ≈ 530 cm².

**STEP 3 - Items:** Breaded tofu pieces, mixed salad greens, cooked kale, grain (quinoa or bulgur), green beans, corn piece, carrot piece, and a few bits of red pepper. No visible sauce or oil pool.
